_about: Sunday 4 Oct configuration for tools/factory.py. Data only: change this file, not the code; each keeper re-reads it before every start. A 'todo' field marks a value that is still open: `plan` prints every one under its command, and docs/plans/sunday-preflight.md wants none left at 08:40. Placeholders: {python} {until} {params} {duel_ticks} {idle_ticks} {config} {date}. Gates doors_open and clock_running default to true; only the keyless feed and the watchdog opt out. Processes are matched by script basename plus mode token. The dealer bots are on (PR #35 and its follow-up #38 merged: duel lock checked before every accept, pause-safe waits, distinct exit statuses); a dealer step that exits non-zero, or exits 0 without a deal or nothing-to-do marker max_attempts times (default 3), is not relaunched. Dealer commands come from section 7 of the Saturday dealer audit.
notify_cmd_howto: notify_cmd stays null until Thiago sets it on the Mini (the one line is in docs/plans/sunday-night-handoff.md): an argv list; the alert text is appended as its last argument and the factory gives it no secrets, so it must read its own token (the Mini keeps it in ~/.config/telegram-notify.env, which tools/mini/tunnel-agent.sh already uses).

processes.name: feed
processes.note: Keyless public recorder; one copy is enough, so the bus claim stops a second machine from starting it.

processes.name: broker
processes.note: Reads its own key from ~/.bazaar/broker.env (--key-file default). The Market Tests (game hours 14.65 hard, 15.0, 17.0, 19.0, 21.0) come from the schedule; status alerts on any dropped match or no match in a test. --policy stall all day (decided Sunday morning: the maxpairs policy lost everywhere it was tested); it is the stall's exact rule.

processes.name: duel
processes.note: One run per wave (Duels III, then the Final): --duel-ticks comes from the schedule event (12 for both) and flags win over the JSON; --late-poll 4 is the 15 s value from the duel audit; --idle-ticks is the window at 15 s ticks and --until the day's close plus 5 min. The window (165 game min) outlasts a wave even if the game clock runs two game hours per wall hour (216 ticks = 108 game min) and closes before the Final's own window opens (21.483 h), so the two never overlap and a crash is relaunched in either wave.

processes.name: abuela
processes.note: On since #35 and #38 merged (duel lock checked before every accept, pause-safe waits, distinct exit statuses). A step counts as done only on a deal or a nothing-to-do line in this dealer's log. No run starts within 25 game min of a duel wave: a run is 40 ticks, 10 wall min, which is 20 game min if the clock runs at two game hours per wall hour.
